shared_elements: linear/incised or low-relief carved figure on an undecorated stone ground
isolated figure with limbs indicated by simple straight strokes
justification: Both surfaces carry a sparse, schematic profile quadruped rendered with straight-line limbs and an elongated body, set against an otherwise blank stone ground, which is the strongest correspondence. However, B additionally shows the animal enclosed within a raised rectangular panel accompanied by a second motif below and a separate vertical element (arm-like) at the edge, while A shows only a single ambiguous incised figure with no framing or companion elements, so the compositional schemes do not match.
